run_hdmi_retargeting: run the SPIDER retargeting simulation using the HDMI simulator backend with Hydra configuration
setup_hdmi_environment: setup the HDMI environment with built-in reference data and configure max simulation steps
optimize_controls_rollout: optimize control trajectories using the rollout optimizer with reward and trace functions
render_simulation_video: render and save simulation videos with reference state comparison using the renderer
sync_environment_state: sync environment state across samples and update viewer with current simulation data
